Paragraph: He has orderly refinement in speech that is remarkable and undelaying, and he speaks propitious, heart-pleasing words.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Rama notes the pleasing, heart-warming quality of Hanuman's speech as further reassurance.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Recognizes the emotionally soothing effect of well-crafted, kind speech.
Outcome/Resolution: Strengthens trust and positive feeling toward Hanuman.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Priya-vakya (kind, pleasing speech as an ethical ideal)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Hanuman embodies priya-vakya, the dharmic ideal of speech that is both truthful and pleasing.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Highlights the therapeutic, calming effect of warm, well-chosen words on listeners' emotional state.
